ai_summary: Vinita Gupta, a member of the Promoter Group of Asian Hotels (West) Limited, fully divested her entire 1.72% stake (200,000 shares) in the company via an "inter-se" transfer on September 30, 2026. This transaction means her individual holding within the promoter group has reduced to zero. While an 'inter-se' transfer can be an internal restructuring, the complete divestment by an individual promoter group member warrants attention regarding its underlying reasons and any potential implications for promoter cohesion.
